correctness.rationale: The source contains exactly the square-free ternary words by exhaustive direct factor testing through nine. Hamming-ball disjointness equals distance at least three. Explicit exhaustive disjoint pairs cover all source words at n=6,7; seven exact orbit-invariant nonnegative dual weight tables cover each possible source at n=8,9 with total costs 63/2 and 48, respectively; an explicit 5-orbit 48-word code at n=9 has minimum Hamming distance at least three. Every assertion is checked with exact arithmetic by the embedded standard-library verifier.

originality.rationale: No compared work yields the capacity of the square-free ternary Hamming-distance-three source at length nine or the 32-message shortest-length claim. Currie treats morphisms; Buschmann–Bystrykh address quaternary barcode filtering/heuristics; Gasnikov–Shur analyze infinite-word wildcard flexibility; Przybocki treats single-word delicacy. The closest indexed non-overlapping-code results impose distinct synchronization constraints. This is best-knowledge originality, with unindexed equivalent computations a residual risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently named earlier square-free restricted Hamming-distance-three capacity table may exist; searches do not prove uniqueness.

value.rationale: This solves the natural shortest-blocklength question for a five-bit payload while forbidding all tandem squares, the minimal alphabet supporting arbitrarily long square-free strings, and corrects a worst-case substitution in the full output space. The simultaneous exact capacity 48 at length nine is an informative zero-error design benchmark and orbit-weight structural certificate, not a recomputation of ordinary square-free word counts.
